scores.notes: Centre: an ornamental throne-form of flame, eyed wheels and wings in swirling cloud, with no face, robe, hands or human silhouette anywhere in the fire or light. Dark cloud and hills reach all four borders.

Moses crouches in a rock cleft at centre with his staff, and a streak of fire and dark cloud sweeps over the summit (upper right) with no figure in it. Gold-leaf sky top-left and painted ground reach all edges.
Smoking, burning summit at top centre with lightning; the smoke and fire hold no face or body. Israelites bow and shield their faces across the foreground, and paint reaches all four borders.

Isaiah with a staff at lower left gazes at a column of light and cloud pouring from the inner shrine (upper centre) with no figure in it; linen-clad attendants bow at both sides. Angel reliefs on the left wall are carvings, not a presence, and the edges are full.

Watercolour: an empty throne drawn in flame at upper centre above a row of burning wheels, with nobody on the seat. White touches at the side borders are cloud highlights matching the interior, and washes reach all edges.

The painted scene sits in a central panel, with plain blank gold-leaf bands about 300px wide down the full left and right sides (the landscape stops abruptly at x~300 and x~1075). Moses' tablets carry glyph-like inscribed marks; the cloud behind him holds no figure.
The flaming throne at top centre is empty, and the four winged living creatures sit below it. A small glyph-like inscription is painted on the riverbank at bottom centre (~x 545-600, y 670-690).

Inside the radiant throne at top centre (~x 800-910, y 70-210) a pale seated robed figure is outlined, with arms on the armrests and drapery over the knees: a human form for God. Edges are full, and Ezekiel's tablet is blank.

The upper left and right borders and the top edge show bare white paper where the sky washes stop short (about 25% near-white at the borders vs 8% in the interior). Moses' tablets carry glyph-like writing; the cloud holds no figure.

In the cloud at upper centre-left (~x 650-760, y 70-300) a bearded face with long hair and a flowing robed body is formed, looming over Moses: a human figure for God. The tablets are blank, and the edges are full.

A gilt painted border runs around all four sides as part of the artwork. Inside, Isaiah stands before cloud and light pouring from open shrine doors, with no figure in the light; attendants bow at both sides.

Watercolour: a tall cloud pillar at the tabernacle door (top centre) with a warm vertical glow inside. An enhanced zoom shows only cloud contours and a light streak, no head or body. Aaron, Miriam and Moses are in the foreground, onlookers at the tents, and washes reach all edges.
A gilt painted border frames all four sides. Moses (centre right) holds two staffs at once, one in each hand. The cloud pillar with its light beam at the tabernacle door has no figure.
An empty throne of fire on burning wheels sits at centre in swirling cloud and flame. A close zoom of the seat shows only flame, with no figure, and dark cloud reaches all borders.

Icon-style Sinai with a red, blue and dark smoke plume from the summit (top centre) and no figure in it. Israelites bow and shield their eyes among tents at the bottom; gold sky and paint reach all edges.
John kneels at lower left facing an empty radiant throne under a rainbow (top centre) beyond a glassy sea; there is no figure on the throne. Painted architecture and rocks reach all borders.

The left border fades into bare white paper along the wall and lower left (about 21% near-white at the left edge vs 8% in the interior). Isaiah gazes at light and incense cloud with no figure in it; the angel reliefs are wall carvings.

The lower-left corner (x 0-30, y ~600-768) shows unpainted cream paper where the rock wash ends in an irregular edge, and the lower right is similarly pale. Moses crouches in a rock niche below a fiery swirl of cloud that holds no figure.

At top centre (~x 710-880, y 0-170) a robed seated figure sits on the glowing throne, hands gripping the armrests and drapery over the knees: a human body for God. Edges are full, and Ezekiel's tablet is blank.
Watercolour Sinai with fire and smoke erupting from the summit and lightning, no figure in the smoke. Israelites bow and cover their faces in the foreground; washes reach all four borders.

Inside the cloud pillar (~x 560-600, y 260-330) a small glowing standing figure of light is visible, with a head-like oval and torso inside a vertical mandorla; it is faint at full size but clear when zoomed. Aaron, Miriam and Moses walk in the foreground, and the edges are full.
Glory of fire and cloud sweeps over the summit (top centre) with no figure in it. Moses sits against a boulder with arms crossed on an open slope rather than pressed into a cleft; the edges are full.

The light at the throne (centre) holds no figure, but both sides of the hall are crowded with horned beasts, winged kneeling figures and a crowned elder (left x 0-200, right x 1150-1376, y 230-540), which the scene excludes. A golden chest stands where the throne should be.

John, seen from behind at left, faces an empty throne in fire and light under a rainbow; a close zoom shows only flame on the seat. The palette is high-key, but line work and washes reach all four borders.
